forensic_audit_section_vi_3_2_case_a_s05.why_degraded_had_fewer_surface_corruptio: In `s05_dau_tieng_viet` (clean), crisp high-contrast prime glyphs (`′`) immediately adjacent to uppercase letters `B′C′D′` caused Tesseract's LSTM glyph segmenter to merge `C′` into the ligature `Œ 7` and `D′` into `D”` (`ABCD.A'B'Œ 7D”`). In `s05_dau_tieng_viet_degraded`, slight blur/downsampling softened the thin prime stroke on `A′` so it vanished (`A`), while `B′C′D′` avoided the `Œ 7` ligature split (`ABCD.AB'C'D'`). Crucially, BOTH single-engine outputs fail `verify_ocr_input_fidelity` (`ABCD.AB'C'D'` is rejected by `INVALID_SOLID_NOTATION` and `primed_labels` mismatch), and `reconcile_dual_ocr_texts` refuses `s05_degraded` via `is_degraded_image=True` (`DEGRADED_IMAGE_REQUIRES_VISION_FALLBACK`).
forensic_audit_section_vi_3_2_case_a_s05.previous_wave_defect_identified: In the previous wave (`correctness-ocr-performance-optimization`), `Case_A_Local_OCR_Verified_Zero_AI` passed a synthetic clean text string (`clean_ocr_text`) into `route_image_or_prepare_outcome` rather than the actual recorded OCR strings (`s05_dau_tieng_viet`). Furthermore, `s05_dau_tieng_viet`'s line-plane intersection clause ('Gọi I là giao điểm của AC\' và mặt phẳng (A\'BD)') was missing from named point premises in `local_geometry_parser.py`.
